name: Whip Pan
description: A half-second whip from one thing to another with heavy blur, landing sharp and level. Built to be used as a transition between two clips.
prompt: Camera whip-pans from {{from}} to {{subject}} in under half a second with heavy motion blur, lands sharp and level, {{extra}}
negative_prompt: slow pan, tilted landing, cuts, morphing, text

slots.name: from
slots.label: Panning from
slots.help: Where the pan starts, e.g. 'the empty doorway'.

slots.name: extra
slots.label: Anything else
slots.default: keep the light of the still

author: kilnry
